Cash vs. Credit Card in Switzerland: How Much Cash Do You Actually Need?

Where contactless payments work everywhere and the few places you still want coins and small bills.

By the SwitzerlandStarter team · October 8, 2026

Where contactless payments work everywhere and the few places you still want coins and small bills.

What travelers should know

Whether you are spending your time in Zurich, Lucerne, and Interlaken, Grindelwald & Jungfrau Region or venturing into smaller towns among Switzerland's 2,113 municipalities, a little advance preparation makes every day smoother.

Practical tips

  • Check train schedules on official SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways apps.
  • Book major sights and intercity trains ahead of peak weekends.
  • Browse our Switzerland City Directory to explore every municipality by region.

Frequently asked questions

How far ahead should I plan for Switzerland?

Book flights and flagship hotels 2–4 months ahead, and high-speed rail tickets 3–6 weeks before departure.
